name: Abs
summary: Returns the magnitude of a number without its sign.

name: Acos
summary: Returns the inverse cosine in radians.

name: Asin
summary: Returns the inverse sine in radians.

name: Atan
summary: Returns the inverse tangent in radians.

name: Average
summary: Averages numeric values supplied as arguments.

name: Ceiling
summary: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the number.

name: Combination
summary: Counts combinations of a requested size from a set.

name: Cos
summary: Returns the cosine of an angle measured in radians.

name: Count
summary: Counts nonempty values among its arguments.

name: Degrees
summary: Converts an angle from radians to degrees.

name: Div
summary: Divides and returns the floor of the quotient.

name: Exp
summary: Returns e raised to the supplied power.

name: Extend
summary: Uses a field value from its first repetition when a calculation repetition needs a value; with no such field context it returns the supplied value.

name: Factorial
summary: Multiplies descending integer values for the requested factorial range.

name: Floor
summary: Returns the greatest integer less than or equal to the number.

name: FV
summary: Calculates the future value from a payment, rate, and period count.

name: GetAsBoolean
summary: Converts a value to a boolean result.

name: GetAsNumber
summary: Returns the numeric interpretation of a value when available.

name: Int
summary: Drops the fractional part toward zero.

name: Lg
summary: Returns the base-two logarithm.

name: Ln
summary: Returns the natural logarithm.

name: Log
summary: Returns the base-ten logarithm.

name: Max
summary: Returns the greatest nonempty argument; values can also be dates, times, or text.

name: Min
summary: Returns the least nonempty argument; values can also be dates, times, or text.

name: Mod
summary: Returns the remainder based on a floor quotient.

name: NPV
summary: Discounts the repetitions of a repeating field, or the related values of a field, by period and adds their present values.
details: The first cash flow is discounted by one period. A return-delimited text list is not split into cash flows: it is read as one number with the separators dropped. Precision behaviour is described in [Numbers and precision](../numbers-and-precision.md).
differences: Repetitions and related values are split into periods; a return-delimited text list is not.

name: PMT
summary: Calculates the periodic payment for a principal, rate, and period count.

name: PV
summary: Calculates present value from a payment, rate, and period count.

name: Radians
summary: Converts an angle from degrees to radians.

name: Random
summary: Returns a random number, so its result depends on random state.

name: Round
summary: Rounds to the requested decimal places using the calculation engine's decimal-aware path.
details: Precision and rounding observations are described in [Numbers and precision](../numbers-and-precision.md).

name: SetPrecision
summary: Returns a number through the engine's decimal-aware precision path; the requested precision does not change this numeric result's displayed digits.
differences: This engine returns the same numeric result for SetPrecision ( 1.234 ; 2 ); formatting a repeating division result to the requested places is unverified.

name: Sign
summary: Returns -1, 0, or 1 according to the number's sign.

name: Sin
summary: Returns the sine of an angle measured in radians.

name: Sqrt
summary: Returns the square root.

name: StDev
summary: Returns the sample standard deviation of numeric values.

name: StDevP
summary: Returns the population standard deviation of numeric values.

name: Sum
summary: Adds numeric values supplied as arguments.

name: Tan
summary: Returns the tangent of an angle measured in radians.

name: Truncate
summary: Drops digits beyond the requested decimal places without rounding.
details: Precision behaviour is described in [Numbers and precision](../numbers-and-precision.md).

name: Variance
summary: Returns the sample variance of numeric values.

name: VarianceP
summary: Returns the population variance of numeric values.
